c.tagline: Saharan palm oasis of brick medinas, salt lakes, and Star Wars sands.

taxi.fareNote: Yellow taxis are metered and cheap; shared 'louages' (fixed-route minibuses) link Tozeur with Nefta, Kebili and other towns, and horse-drawn 'calèches' run tourist loops through the oasis. No ride-hailing apps operate.

emergency.note: 197 reaches the police and 190 the ambulance/SAMU; 198 is the civil-protection/fire service.

avoid.reason: Southern desert — remote areas near the Algeria/Libya borders are restricted; check advisories

hood_desc: Tozeur's 14th-century medina, a warren of alleys built from ochre bricks laid in raised geometric patterns unique to the Jerid; small guesthouses, craft shops and museums make it the atmospheric historic base.
The modern spine of town along the main avenue, with cafes, banks, the covered market and the louage/bus stations; the practical, central place to sort logistics and eat.

A landscaped strip of resort hotels, spas and pools running toward the oasis and the Dar Cheraït museum and Chak Wak heritage park; best for travelers wanting a full-service base with a pool after desert days.

The edge of Tozeur's vast palm grove — some 200,000 date palms fed by natural springs — laced with irrigation channels, garden plots and shaded tracks for walking, biking or a calèche ride; green, quiet and cool.
The old oasis settlement at the palm grove's heart, with the Belvédère rocks, an ancient mosque and traditional farming hamlets; a calm, local counterpoint to the tourist strip.

water.note: Drink bottled water; tap water is not reliable for visitors.

transit.hours: Taxis run through the day and evening; louages depart when full, mostly in daylight.
transit.note: Tozeur has no urban bus network; the town is small and flat, so most trips are on foot, by cheap metered taxi, or by calèche or bicycle through the oasis.
transit.pay: Fares are paid in cash (dinars) to the driver; taxis are metered and louages charge a fixed per-seat rate.

bus: SNTRI intercity coaches to Tunis (~7 hr), Kairouan and Gafsa
Louages (shared minibuses) to Nefta, Kebili, Gafsa and Douz
train: No passenger rail to Tozeur; nearest railhead is Metlaoui/Gafsa (the Lézard Rouge tourist train runs from Metlaoui)

transit.m: Metered taxi to the city centre (~5-10 min)

tip.r: ~10% at restaurants; round up for taxis and tip guides and hotel staff a dinar or two.
